Hibob is an all-in-one, cloud-based HR and benefits platform that gives fast-growing businesses a better way to engage and manage their employees. # **Working with Hibob** This section describes the the steps to start working on the API ## **Pre-work** Steps are written based on the Hibob portal. It is subject to change and may need to get in touch with the technical team at that point of time to understand the latest updates / upgrades / depreciation of the processes and API’s. ### **Authorization** Hibob has 2 types of authorization based on the API we use. - Basic - Token based Some API accepts both types of authorization whereas some can only 1 type. Details can be obtained from the Hibob [site](https://apidocs.hibob.com/reference/post_people-search "https://apidocs.hibob.com/reference/post_people-search"). #### **Basic Authorization** To use the API which takes basic authorization, Hibob Admin has to create the service user with a password and share it with the disprz team. ##### Service user Service users are dedicated API users that are used to pull data from or push data to Bob. The service users are detached from any actual employee and have custom permissions that are defined by the admin. These users cannot "log in" to Bob and are used only by the HiBob public API. - An Hibob admin user has the ability to create this service-users in the Integration section of the platform. - While creating the user itself, their corresponding token gets generated. It has to be saved cautiously for future use. - If there is an existing service group available that is related to API, then admins can associate the created user to that group. - If any specific permission needs to be granted and if those permissions are not available in the existing groups, create a new one, give necessary permissions and then associate this user to the group. - A service user must be used with basic access authentication. - The request should contain a header field in the form of Authorization: Basic , where credentials is the Base64 encoding of ID and token joined by a single colon : like below Authorization: Basic Base64.encode(SERVICE-202:Qe8q89RwbzeS7mmhMcAsN1crM73m6MdbjewGCCUY) - One can refresh a user’s token by just clicking the three-dot menu to the right of the service user and clicking Refresh Token. Note that the previous token will be revoked. #### **Token based** Hibob admins do have access to generate tokens in the platform. Either client or the Hibob SPoC can help us to get one. To verify the generated token, please use the same in the command below. curl -H "Authorization:{{API\_TOKEN}}" [https://api.hibob.com/api/user](https://api.hibob.com/api/user "https://api.hibob.com/api/user") In the Administration screen, go to profile on top-right and choose ‘API Access’ menu item. This will show you the token that can be used. Make sure all required scopes are enabled and click save. ## **Scope & Functionality** Scopes can be set for both types of authorization. For Token based, we saw how to enable required scopes. In this section, we will see how to enable required functionality for Basic authentication. Navigate to ‘Settings’ → ‘Permissions Groups’ → ‘Features’ → ‘Advanced Analytics’. Click the ‘Edit Permission’ button on the top right corner. Choose all required sections that need to be flown to the disprz platform. Navigate to ‘Settings’ → ‘Permissions Groups’ → ‘Peoples Data’ → ‘Access Rights’. Click the ‘Edit Permission’ button on the top right corner. Choose the required people who all need to be sent to the disprz platform. One of the main features that disprz needed would be the ‘Lifecycle’ in ‘Advanced Analytics’ and the corresponding status in access rights could be choosing all status of ‘Lifecycle Status’ in the ‘Access Rights’. ![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfVjs1Wg8tnagJEuCF91JDv3lDhJdO8KWC8DBI-a81uO0QSq0IaVethXx7dhkdqubLfksvXppWq--WwGGy6PzdCtc-rMRIRta8Tp_QiD1HMWitV000enWuEQP5rFmJpiD5r08smRNiTN_3Rsev2gy8Zaz_g?key=rrz1jJNc6XYRx4htSXDQyw) ## **Query parameters** There are a couple of the API query parameters that need to be taken into account in the request to get the response in human readable format. If these are not used, the response will be in machine readable format only. ### **includeHumanReadable** With this query param (when set to true), in addition to the standard output (machine readable data), Bob will return a new JSON node, "humanReadable", per employee. The new node has the exact structure as the main body, but all the values of the fields are strings and contain the human readable strings, as displayed in Bob’s UI. ### **humanReadable** When this query param is turned on, Bob will return the complete data in a Human readable way. This means all the list items will be returned with their actual values, and all the date, currencies, and others will appear as they appear in the UI according to the user settings. **Note**:  _The human-readable will only return fields that are populated in the UI for the employee. To get all the null fields, you should use the IncludeHumanReadalbe and grab the fields from the non-human readable section._ # **People API** This API is to pull one or more employee data based on the filter criteria. If the filter parameter is used, one employee detail can be retrieved whereas if we send the API without ‘filter’ parameter like below sample, it will respond with all employee data. ## **API request** curl --location ' [https://api.hibob.com/v1/people/search](https://api.hibob.com/v1/people/search "https://api.hibob.com/v1/people/search")' \ --header 'accept: application/json' \ --header 'authorization: Basic abcd=1234' \ --header 'content-type: application/json' \ --data ' { "fields": \[\ \     "[![](https://domains.atom.com/assets/images/atom-favicon.png)Root.id is for sale at Atom.com!](http://root.id/) ",\ \     "root.firstName",\ \     "root.surname",\ \     "root.email",\ \     "work.site",\ \     "work.department",\ \     "about.superpowers",\ \     "work.tenureDuration.humanize",\ \     "work.reportsTo.email",\ \     “internal.status”\ \ \], "showInactive": false, "humanReadable": "true", "includeHumanReadable" : "false" } ' This sample request will retrieve all employee fields (mentioned in the field parameter section) in the database. If we want to retrieve only one record, please add the below filter after the fields parameter. "filters": \[\ \     {\ \       "fieldPath": "[![](https://domains.atom.com/assets/images/atom-favicon.png)Root.id is for sale at Atom.com!](http://root.id/) ",\ \       "operator": "equals",\ \       "values": \[\ \         "xxxxxx",\ \         "yyyyyy"\ \       \]\ \     }\ \ \], The ‘fieldPath’ attribute can take only 2 parameters - [![](https://domains.atom.com/assets/images/atom-favicon.png)Root.id is for sale at Atom.com!](http://root.id/) or root.email. That infers that when the filter parameter is passed, at the max we can retrieve only one employee record per API request. # **Training API** Due to the nature of the platform's needs, disprz pulls the user data as well as associate training to the users. Below API’s are used to create and list training per user. ## **List** This API returns the list of training records of a given employee using the GET method. ### **Request** curl --request GET \      --url [https://api.hibob.com/v1/people/3200954374226445032/training](https://api.hibob.com/v1/people/3200954374226445032/training "https://api.hibob.com/v1/people/3200954374226445032/training") \      --header 'Authorization: abcd1234’\      --header 'accept: application/json' ### **Response** { "values": \[\ \     {\ \       "id": 638043,\ \       "name": "258928101",\ \       "description": "Programming with C language",\ \       "startDate": "2023-11-02",\ \       "endDate": "2023-11-07",\ \       "documentId": null,\ \       "frequency": null,\ \       "cost": null,\ \       "status": null,\ \       "customColumns": {}\ \     },\ \     {\ \       "id": 638042,\ \       "name": "Training",\ \       "description": "New Training",\ \       "startDate": "2023-11-01",\ \       "endDate": "2023-11-08",\ \       "documentId": null,\ \       "frequency": "Once",\ \       "cost": null,\ \       "status": "Completed",\ \       "customColumns": {}\ \     }\ \ \] } ## **Create Training** Same API is used to add new training to the users with POST method. curl --location ' [https://api.hibob.com/v1/people/id/training](https://api.hibob.com/v1/people/id/training "https://api.hibob.com/v1/people/id/training")' \ --header 'Authorization: abcd=1234’\ --header 'accept: application/json' \ --header 'content-type: application/json' \ --data ' { "id": 0, "reason": "string", "effectiveDate": "2023-11-08", "name": "string", "description": "string", "cost": {     "value": 0,     "currency": "string" }, "status": "string", "frequency": "string", "startDate": "2023-11-08", "endDate": "2023-11-08", "documentId": 0 } ' # **Web hooks** Employees change events can be subscribed in Hibob, in case near-real-time updates need to be synchronized with the disprz platform. Once respective events are subscribed via this webhook, Hibob will notify the disprz platform with a payload of the employee data. Events can be subscribed to all employees or segments of employees, which is configurable in the Hibob platform under Integration section. Below are the events that can be subscribed to. \\*\\* This is not supported by the disprz platform when this document was created \*\* | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | **Event** | **Type** | **Description** | | Employee Created | employee.created | | | Employee Joined | employee.joined | When an employee's start date has occurred. | | Employee Left | employee.left | When an employee's termination date has occurred. | | Employe Updated | employee.updated | | | Employee Deleted | employee.deleted | | | Employee Inactivated | | | | Employee Activated | | | ## **Http Headers** Each employee event will contain a header key named "Get-Employee" and a value to point to the GET people Api. For example: Get-Employee: " [https://api.hibob.com/v1/people/9a048006-436c-44](https://api.hibob.com/v1/people/9a048006-436c-44 "https://api.hibob.com/v1/people/9a048006-436c-44")" where root.email | UserID | | root.firstName | FirstName | | root.surname | LastName | | root.email | Email | | work.workMobile | Mobile Number | | work.title | Designation | | work.department | Department | | work.reportsTo.email / [work.reportsTo.id](http://work.reportsto.id/ "http://work.reportsTo.id") | Manager UserID | | internal.status | User Status | # **Appendix** ## **Rate limit** Some of the endpoints have a rate limit to prevent misuse of the API endpoints and to protect the platform. A rate limit is enforced on a token level ( user or service ) and is calculated per minute.
